rule: Rule by vtable slot. The shape classes are ShapeBase (phys_fn_001273) and the six classes whose constructors call it; the tables below are the eight vtables those seven constructors store, each with the store that establishes it. A table stored in an object's first word by a constructor that calls ShapeBase's constructor implements the Shape interface, whose shared slots are ShapeBase's twelve; the box-hull facade BoxShape's constructor stores at +0xe0 is an interface of its own. A slot is a collision slot when the collision pipeline dispatches through it on a receiver of its interface. A shared slot is one virtual method on every class, so its verdict holds for every class's implementation of it; a slot past the shared ones, and every slot of the box-hull facade, is ruled per class. The collision pipeline and its bound are under `pipeline`. validate_inventory.py derives every verdict from the image through collision_pipeline, which reconcile_analysis.py runs too, and rejects a table that disagrees in either direction: a dispatch site's receiver is its row's `this` where a table names the row, and is typed in `receivers` everywhere else. The slot's name decides nothing. A slot target takes the phase of its slot, collision 3 and object model 5, and a row several slots name must get one phase from all of them or be listed as an exception. A row that stores a shape table -- a constructor or a destructor -- is object model. The two Prunable owner adapters take the phase of the one slot their body calls. A helper, a row whose every direct caller is a ruled row, whose address is never taken and which has no translation unit, export pin or table of its own, takes the one phase its callers are ruled to. A body the linker folded and shared outside the shape classes is shared runtime, Phase 2; a body another translation unit owns is left to it. Every ruled row, and every continuation row of one, records phase_provenance slot_ruling, and validate_inventory.py recomputes the phase from this file. A direct call from the collision pipeline into an object-model row does not move it: phys_fn_001874, the [MESH][MESH] vertex callback phys_fn_001876 passes at 0x00046d15, builds two temporary SphereShapes through phys_fn_001349, phys_fn_001357 and phys_fn_001351 as a client of the object model, and all three are Phase 5 rows, so the pipeline ends at each of them.

pipeline.bound: The collision pipeline starts at the 39 function pointers phys_fn_002338 stores into the two dispatch matrices and is closed over direct calls and jumps, tail calls, the callbacks its rows pass as immediates, the global function pointers it calls through and virtual calls through collision slots. It traverses the rows Phases 3 and 4 own: Phase 3's narrow phase, and Phase 4's spatial and acceleration structures, which collision consumes -- phys_fn_004886 is Prunable::updateWorldBox, broadphase pruning code that sits in Phase 4 only because its bytes lie inside the OPCODE span. A direct call, tail call or passed callback into a row any other phase owns ends it: Phase 2's shared runtime, and Phases 5, 6, 7 and 8. So does an exception this file calls shared or external. The target of a collision slot, and every entry the image stores in a global function pointer the pipeline calls through, is in the pipeline whatever its phase, because that phase is what this ruling decides. Decided by the orchestrator in the review of dd5e205, together with the rule that verdicts are per interface slot. The two worked examples below are checked: each hop's site is in its row, and each row is in the pipeline exactly when it says so.

worked_examples.note: Shape slot 6 (owner update) stays object model. Read without the bound, this path makes it collision: matrix A [SPHERE][SPHERE] reaches the continuous-collision body, which calls phys_fn_000774, which calls phys_fn_000022, whose jmp dword ptr [eax + 0x18] at 0x00001855 dispatches slot 6 on actor+0x10, the COMPOUND; that lands in phys_fn_001018, which calls slot 6 on every child at 0x000227f9. phys_fn_000022 is Phase 2 shared runtime, so the pipeline ends at the call into it and the dispatch is not the pipeline's. PLANE slot 8, which is object model: no virtual call anywhere in the image dispatches slot 8 on a shape, so the slot does not place this row. It is the cached world-AABB reader. Its only direct caller is COMPOUND slot 9 (phys_fn_001030, collision), which calls it for every child at 0x00022c6a, and it refreshes the box through phys_fn_004886 at 0x000254c7, the path slot 9 is dispatched through. It is ruled collision on that caller, and validate_inventory.py checks that every direct caller of a row ruled this way is a ruled row of its phase.
